title: Ready in advance, burst out laughing
goal: Say something was done in advance or left that way with -(Y)p goýmak, and that it happened all at once with -(Y)p goýbermek; read a story that uses the whole unit.

intro.text: *Goýmak* after `-(Y)p` says the result stays for later: *Biletleri alyp goýdum* (I've bought the tickets in advance), *Gapyny açyp goýdy* (he left the door open). *Goýbermek* on its own is **let go**; after `-(Y)p` it is **all at once**: *Ol gülüp goýberdi* (she burst out laughing).

vocab.en: to light (a fire, a lamp); to switch on

exercises.question: How do you say **I bought the tickets in advance**?

why.1: *Goýbermek* is **let go, all at once**: it keeps nothing for later.

exercises.explain: *alyp goýdum*: bought, and they're ready for later.

accept: goýdy

reject.why: *Ýakyp berdi* is **switched it on for someone**. Left on: *ýakyp goýdy*.

exercises.explain: *ýakyp goýdy*: switched it on and left it that way.

exercises.explain: *gülüp goýberdi*: laughed all at once, without holding back.

why.1: *Satmak* is **to sell**: the car is gone.

exercises.explain: *satyp goýberdi*: sold it off, let it go for good.

reject.why: *Bermek* is **for someone**. Put away for later: *gizläp goýdum*.
*Goýbermek* is **let go**. Put away for later: *gizläp goýdum*.

exercises.explain: *gizläp goýdum*: hid it, and it stays there for later. The *e* of *gizle-* becomes *ä* before *-p*.

exercises.passage:
Düýn Merjeniň doglan günüdi. Onuň dostlary oňa hiç zat aýtman, kiçijik toý taýýarladylar. Bahar sowgady öňünden alyp, öz öýünde gizläp goýdy. Döwran tort bişirip goýdy. Merjen işden gelmezden öň, olar onuň öýüne gelip, çyralary öçürdiler we garaşdylar.

Merjen içeri giren badyna, olar çyralary ýakdylar. Merjen ilki gorkdy, soňra gülüp goýberdi. Ol örän begenendigi üçin, biraz aglap hem goýberdi! Bahar oňa sowgadyny berdi: kümüş ýüzük. Merjen ýüzügi dakyp gördi we ony örän halady.

glossary.en: to switch off, to put out

exercises.translation: Yesterday was Merjen's birthday. Without telling her anything, her friends got a little party ready. Bahar bought the present in advance and hid it at her own place. Döwran baked a cake and had it ready. Before Merjen came home from work, they came to her house, switched off the lights and waited. As soon as Merjen came in, they switched the lights on. At first Merjen was frightened, then she burst out laughing. Because she was so happy, she even burst into tears a little! Bahar gave her the present: a silver ring. Merjen tried the ring on and liked it very much.

questions.q: Where did Bahar keep the present?
options: she hid it at her own place
questions.explain: *Öz öýünde gizläp goýdy*: hid it at her own place, for later.

questions.q: Why did Merjen cry a little?
options: because she didn't like the ring
